question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Deceive
solution:
The correct answer is "**Betray**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Deceive" means to mislead or trick someone.**(धोखा देना)
 
• **"Betray" also means to deceive or trick someone, but with the added element of breaking trust or loyalty.**(विश्वासघात करना)
 
• Example: He deceived his friend by pretending to be on his side, but in reality, he was betraying him by working with their enemy.
 
 
 
• Thus, it can be concluded that the word "betray" is the synonym of the word "deceive."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2, Assist, means to help or support someone. (सहायता देना)
 
• Option 3, Aid, also means to help or support someone, but often in a more formal or official capacity.(सहायता)
 
• Option 4, Release, means to set free or let go.(मुक्त करना)
